name: University of Newcastle Shaping Futures Scholarship
summary: Lump-sum scholarship for full-time UON undergraduates affected by educational disadvantage.
key: A benefit of $5000 to be paid as a lump sum.
who: Enrolled in any year of a UON undergraduate degree
GPA of 4.0 for continuing students, or an entry rank for commencing students
Able to show the impact of educational disadvantage
how: Apply through the online portal with a one-page personal statement (PDF uploads only)
catches: Can't be held with another UON donor-funded or sponsored scholarship

source.label: University of Newcastle: Shaping Futures Scholarships
